title: Mawdeep: stairs, gates and a way out
changes: The ways down are now stairwells you can't miss: steps going down into a dark arch with a glow from below, and two lit torches at the top of each.
Stairs and ropes show on the minimap and the world map, with where they lead.
The lair gates are now real portcullis gates between heavy posts. They wind up into the lintel when opened and drop back down when shut.
Cave walls now only show their rock face on the side facing you. Beyond the walls is just the dark rock, with no blocky border.
A rope hangs down into the Hide-Mother's den: climb it to get straight back to the woods.
